title: Zesty Crumbly Italian Meat Ribollita
description: A hearty Italian soup featuring rest-meat and chilled butter, perfect for a special occasion. This dish is sugar-free-friendly and offers a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: In a large pot, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the canned diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and italian seasoning, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the soup for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chilled butter until it is fully incorporated and the soup has a creamy texture.
Serve the soup hot, topped with grated parmesan cheese.
Let the soup cool to room temperature, then refrigerate it overnight to allow the flavors to meld.
Reheat the soup gently over low heat before serving.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
